edition_note: Fan-made guide to the 55-entry trophy list supplied with this competition. The starter data contains no hidden field; hidden is recorded as false where no source value was supplied.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.note: Story unlocks, missable warning, 100% cleanup, activity requirements, and per-trophy route notes.

sources.title: PowerPyx — All Meditation Spot Locations
sources.note: Meditation counts, map/progress menu route, and the possible Chapter 1 missable.

sources.title: PowerPyx — All Challenges Guide
sources.note: Challenge total, where to track completed challenges, and 50/70 thresholds.

sources.title: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
sources.note: Consulted for context that guide sites label some trophies hidden; not used to replace the competition starter's trophy fields.

sources.title: Competition starter trophy list
sources.note: The local starter data is the source of every displayed name, description, and grade; it contains no hidden flags.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies; the list grants the platinum when the remaining awards are complete. This is the list's stated condition, not an independently tested unlock. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Final award: finish every remaining trophy.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening main mission Gone Fishing. PowerPyx identifies it as an automatic Chapter 1 story unlock. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Begin with Gone Fishing; the trophy is story-linked.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The guide reports the award after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What’s in the Bag?. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: Reported as an automatic chapter award.
trophies.roadmap: Continue the story into Chapter 2.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. PowerPyx places the unlock after the first Chapter 3 main mission, Welcome to Vice City. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: Reported as an automatic chapter award.
trophies.roadmap: Finish the chapter and continue into Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. The guide reports the award after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: Reported as an automatic chapter award.
trophies.roadmap: Continue through the first two Chapter 4 missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. PowerPyx lists Starting From Zero as the final Chapter 4 main mission and the unlock point. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: Reported as an automatic chapter award.
trophies.roadmap: Complete Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. PowerPyx identifies Starting From Zero as the listed finale and says the trophy unlocks automatically there. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Reach and complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2; the guide describes this as a story unlock. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Complete the named Chapter 2 mission when it appears.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Complete the named story mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child’s Play. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Complete the named story mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Complete the named story mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Complete the named story mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Complete the named story mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and use its checklist to fill the remaining categories. PowerPyx reports that story progress counts, everything for the checklist remains available in free roam, and the checklist does not require every activity or collectible. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: The consulted roadmap says checklist items remain available after the story.
trophies.roadmap: Use the post-story 100% checklist as the master cleanup list.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt events. The roadmap recommends mixing stunt categories and tracking names under Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots; it does not require challenge bonuses attached to each stunt. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Track completed stunt names and build toward 250 across categories.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt. Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities to spot an unfinished type. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Use the Activities progress page to sample each of the nine listed types.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PowerPyx points to Griffin Shooting Range and Rodgers Ranch and links a dedicated medal guide; use the game's range challenge tracker to find any remaining medals. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: The guide reports Kenton returns after a temporary story absence.
trophies.roadmap: Unlock the ranges, then clear their 42 challenges and gold medals.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 listed locations. The exact location-by-location route was not confirmed in the pages consulted; use the activity markers and verify the count in the in-game tracker. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Clear each marked Top Fun race and confirm the total reaches 14.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races. The guide's activity overview confirms race challenges count among activity types, but does not list a specific set of 20 here; favor new race markers and track the trophy counter. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Choose races you have not won before until the counter reaches 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal's fishing challenge and finish with a better result than Cal. The consulted roadmap does not pin down his meeting point or the challenge rules, so this is description-led advice; follow the in-game prompt. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: No missable condition identified in the consulted guide.
trophies.roadmap: Take the fishing challenge when its character marker appears.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Start an arcade game and finish one full game. The competition list does not name the machine or venue, so use an arcade marker and follow its on-screen instructions. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Complete one arcade cabinet game during free roam.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's mission strand until its final mission is complete. A specific mission name and starting location were not verified in the sources consulted; use the character's mission marker and strand log. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: The consulted roadmap generally reports side strands remain available after the story; verify Andy's marker in-game.
trophies.roadmap: Finish Andy's strand before final cleanup if its marker is available.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the last mission in Kenton's strand. The roadmap says Kenton can be temporarily unavailable, then returns during Chapters 2–3; wait for his text or call Brian as Jason if the strand stalls. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: Reported as temporarily unavailable, not missable; the guide gives a return window in Chapters 2–3.
trophies.roadmap: Pick up Kenton's strand when it returns, then complete its finale.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's five-quest line, ending with Hometown Heroes. PowerPyx says the strand appears after Chapter 2's Coffee Break and starts at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: The guide says Billy's quests remain available after the story.
trophies.roadmap: Start at Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break and finish all five missions.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying stranger strands; the trophy tracker shows the total. The guide confirms examples for Kirk, Kyle, Yago, and Pilot Pete, and warns that some optional character strands do not count. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: PowerPyx reports these open-world strands remain after the story.
trophies.roadmap: Favor confirmed stranger strands and monitor the trophy counter until it reaches eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List strand. PowerPyx says it appears after Chapter 3's Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS and asks Jason to deliver 16 requested sports cars; the strand can be completed after the story. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: Reported to remain available after the story.
trophies.roadmap: Unlock Randy's list in Chapter 3, then finish its requested deliveries and finale.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's strand through its final mission. The pages consulted do not verify the mission names or starting location; use the strand marker and its mission log rather than guessing. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: The general roadmap says trophy-related quest givers return after story progression.
trophies.roadmap: Complete Tyrone's strand when its marker is available.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The guide lists 18 meditations across 10 spots. Track them at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations and filter Map > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida. PowerPyx flags a Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house as potentially missable: after Down to Earth, speak to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, and accept. Whether that extra counter is required remains unclear. [S1][S2]
trophies.missable_note: Potentially missable: the Chapter 1 Jason's house meditation may count, but the guide says its necessity is unresolved. Do it early to be safe.
trophies.roadmap: Do Jason's house meditation in Chapter 1, then clear all 18 entries shown in the progress menu.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Meet Bret and complete the requested hunt for a unique animal. PowerPyx's roadmap says his first quest provides a hunting rifle and marks hunting spots; it notes that the exact animal for this trophy was still being confirmed. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Start Bret's hunting strand and complete the unique-animal request.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. The consulted trophy roadmap links a separate 18-set-location guide; this entry does not reproduce an unverified card-by-card route. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: No missable condition reported in the consulted roadmap.
trophies.roadmap: Use the in-game collectible tracker and finish any three complete card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app. PowerPyx says there are more than 100 scannable objects across landmarks, curiosities, and sculptures; use the app's scan action and track the trophy counter. [S1]
trophies.roadmap: Scan new WAiNK targets as you explore until the tracker reaches 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of 80 challenges. Check Progress > Challenges; the completed checkmark appears on each challenge. The guide notes 70 are needed for the completion checklist, so that route also clears this trophy. [S1][S3]
trophies.missable_note: PowerPyx says challenges are available from the start.
trophies.roadmap: Complete the easiest 50 challenge entries; continue to 70 if pursuing 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, raise the wanted level to four stars, then escape until the police search ends. The exact partner trigger and getaway method were not verified in the consulted material; use cover and break line of sight, then confirm the award. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Attempt during free roam when partner play is available.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in sequence while keeping the same wanted level active between robberies. The source list gives the condition but no shop route; plan nearby stores and do not let the wanted level clear between stops. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Choose three nearby shops and keep pursuit active until the third robbery is complete.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. The trophy description does not specify an app or method, so this guide recommends driving varied models and checking the trophy counter rather than assuming a particular scan mechanic. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Use many distinct vehicle models during exploration until the counter reaches 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus when at least five enemies are within reach, then take all five down before that single activation ends. A specific fill method and location were not verified in the consulted sources. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Build Combat Focus and save its use for a group of five enemies.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, leave by an unexpected or unauthorized departure. The trophy description does not identify the vehicle, terminal, or trigger; try the airport after free roam opens and follow the game's response. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Try after story access to VCIA, then verify the trophy counter.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The provided description is a hint rather than a complete requirement. The exact action involving Rhino tanks is not verified by the sources consulted, so this ledger leaves the trigger unresolved instead of guessing. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Return after finding a reliable trigger; no specific step is verified here.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without alerting anyone. No store or entry route was confirmed in the consulted pages; scout for a jewelry business, avoid witnesses, and leave without triggering detection. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Attempt after locating a jewelry store during exploration.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape from each. The description establishes the count, but the consulted material does not confirm the five locations or whether repeat visits count; record separate successful escapes and check the trophy tracker. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Work through five distinct vault robberies and survive each getaway.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away successfully. No route or required escape distance was verified, so follow the robbery prompt and make sure the wanted pursuit fully ends. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Complete one armored-truck robbery and escape during free roam.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal every region of Leonida. The supplied description gives no region count, so uncover the full map and use the map's exploration or area tracker to identify dark gaps. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Sweep the map systematically, checking the region tracker as you go.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each gang. The starter list gives no gang count or operation locations; keep a written checklist of gang names and confirm one successful robbery for each. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Identify the gangs and clear one operation per group during cleanup.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order or enjoy a cocktail at a place with a view on Ocean Beach. The description does not identify a bar or time window; explore the beachfront and use the interaction prompt at a suitable venue. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Try a beachfront drink interaction once the area is accessible.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Use a vehicle to break out of a showroom in the manner suggested by the description. The source list gives no exact showroom or vehicle, so treat the specific setup as unverified and follow any in-game robbery prompt. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Attempt at a showroom during free roam; confirm the award before leaving.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete a bowling action. The description does not specify the required score or match result; follow the alley's prompt and check the trophy list afterward. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Visit the named bowling alley and finish a game or prompted activity.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This description is an opaque hint, and the consulted sources do not verify its trigger. The roadmap does not guess at a stat, relationship level, or activity; return when a reliable route is available. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: No verified step yet; avoid treating an inferred partnership activity as confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description does not state which choices count. A site consulted mentions a progress count, but no matching authoritative trigger was verified; make choices naturally and check the trophy tracker rather than grinding an assumed action. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Leave for cleanup until the game or a verified guide identifies the counted choice.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description suggests a success on a second attempt, but neither the activity nor the retry condition is verified in the sources consulted. Do not rely on a guessed minigame; check back when a confirmed method is available. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: No verified step; avoid spending time on speculative retries.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The hint points to an unusual encounter, but the consulted pages do not verify what to find or where. Explore optional events and record any confirmed trigger; this entry intentionally leaves the method open. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Keep for open-world cleanup; no location is verified here.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The phrase suggests striking a target with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but the exact input and target are unverified. Try only once a safe, confirmed method is available; the wording alone is not a tested walkthrough. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Leave for cleanup; verify the intended melee drive-by action first.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Build a cumulative $250,000 total by laundering marked bills through contacts. PowerPyx says the Dye Pack Jammer becomes available after Chapter 3's Credit Check; bank and payday-loan robberies provide marked bills, which can be delivered to a fence. [S1]
trophies.missable_note: The roadmap describes this as cumulative and naturally achievable during robbery cleanup.
trophies.roadmap: Unlock the jammer, then track delivered marked bills toward $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 at shops. The description gives a cumulative target but does not clarify eligible stores; make ordinary purchases across shop types and watch the trophy counter. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Reserve some earnings for purchases and spend until the tracker confirms $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property. The starter list does not state how many properties or their locations, so use the in-game property map and buy each garage marked as available. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Use the property map as a checklist and acquire all garage listings.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. The provided description identifies both the app and count; the app's exact unlock and registration steps were not confirmed in the consulted pages. [S5]
trophies.roadmap: Open Scooter Bros, register distinct eligible vehicles, and stop when the count reaches ten.
